d: Watch this video as Firstpost explains Somali President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud’s explosive attack against the United Arab Emirates, accusing Abu Dhabi of burning trust and undermining national sovereignty. In a fiery address to the nation, Mohamud charged that the UAE has bypassed the federal government to secure unauthorized port deals, military bases, and regional alliances in Berbera, Bosaso, and Kismayo.
